description: Create a to-do on a user's task list (date only, no time — use lacrm_create_event for timed things). Optionally attach it to a contact. Returns { TaskId }. LACRM: CreateTask.

assigned_to.description: UserId to assign to. Default: you.

calendar_id.description: Calendar to file it under. Default: your primary (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

contact_id.description: Attach the task to this contact or company (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

name.description: Task name shown on the task list.

name: lacrm_create_task
title: Create a task
